classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Generate one small (~80 aa) unconditional de novo soluble-protein backbone with RFdiffusion, design a compact sequence panel with ProteinMPNN, refold the top sequence with protenix_v2, apply protein_qc for biophysical pre-filtering, and aggregate all evidence into a single ranked candidate with rank_designs.
assumptions: Target length 70–100 residues; no topology, symmetry, or expression-host constraint was supplied; unconditional generation is appropriate.
Single rfdiffusion backbone shard (num_designs=1) keeps GPU budget compact; 50 diffusion steps is the default quality/speed trade-off.
ProteinMPNN generates 4 sequences at temperature 0.1 for a near-deterministic but slightly diverse panel; all 4 candidate objects are forwarded to rank_designs.
proteinmpnn emits a protenix_input_json field containing an auto-prepared Protenix-format JSON for the top-ranked sequence, enabling direct protenix_v2 wiring.
protenix_v2 refolds only the top-ranked ProteinMPNN sequence (n_sample=1, seeds=[101]) to minimise runtime while providing pLDDT/pTM evidence.
protein_qc runs on the top sequence in parallel with refolding; all five scalars (plddt, polybasic, gravy, instability_index, pi) are requested.
rank_designs top_k=1 returns the single best candidate; no submit_candidate node is included — final submission is a post-round decision.
Seed 42 is used for rfdiffusion and proteinmpnn to ensure reproducibility.
No binder, ligand, motif-scaffolding, or literature context is required for this generic de novo objective.

success_criteria.backbone_generated: rfdiffusion produces a valid PDB backbone in the 70–100 aa range.
success_criteria.sequences_designed: proteinmpnn returns 4 ranked sequences with recovery scores for the generated backbone.
success_criteria.structure_predicted: protenix_v2 returns a prediction record with pLDDT and pTM for the top ProteinMPNN sequence.
success_criteria.qc_passed: protein_qc returns all five scalar metrics; GRAVY > -1.0 and instability_index < 40 are desired solubility thresholds.
success_criteria.ranked_output: rank_designs returns exactly 1 ranked candidate aggregating backbone, sequence, structure-prediction, and QC evidence.
